Now let me also check if there are existing entries for the OpenReview and other links that papers have:

For CoRAG - code is on OpenReview (https://openreview.net/forum?id=gUPGGCM4WH) - this is a forum page, not a code repo.

For Parametric RAG - the link is to a tutorial site (https://sites.google.com/view/sigir2025-tutorial-dprag/home-page)

For the Survey - no code available.

Let me check if there's an OpenReview link already:

args.sql: SELECT id, link FROM code WHERE link LIKE '%openreview%' OR link LIKE '%sites.google%'
